title: Peer DataGrids / dual focals for one job
cues: Two peer worklists or DataGrids on the same triage route — e.g. David's 10 today + Queue both painting full grids with the same cite
ban: One job gets one focal grid; peers fold to saved-view / filter / XOR — never silent delete.
remediation: Emit collapse-peer-grids plan; run dual-grid XOR (peer title → filter chip + shared DataGrid); keep one grid in the fold; re-measure dual-focal.
